name: Hydrating Face Cream
description: Daily moisturizer with hyaluronic acid for soft, hydrated skin.
usage: Apply to clean face morning and evening with gentle circular motions.

name: Vitamin C Serum
description: Brightening serum that helps improve uneven tone and dullness.
usage: Use 3-4 drops on clean skin before moisturizer, once daily.

name: Gentle Cleansing Gel
description: Mild gel cleanser that removes impurities without drying the skin.
usage: Massage onto damp skin, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

name: Nourishing Body Lotion
description: Rich body lotion with shea butter for long-lasting hydration.
usage: Apply generously to body after showering or whenever skin feels dry.

name: SPF 50 Sun Fluid
description: Lightweight broad-spectrum sunscreen for daily UV protection.
usage: Apply as the final step of morning skincare, 15 minutes before sun exposure.
